entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The maximum security prison's tall..."
entries.dialogueText: The maximum security prison's tall metal gates opened and a convoy of vehicles followed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The convoy was escorted on all side..."
entries.dialogueText: The convoy was escorted on all sides by many police cars and armored police carriers. Soon, they arrived at Plaza Drazia, a square in the city center where public executions traditionally took place.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Sila Orica had been placed on a..."
entries.dialogueText: The Sila Orica had been placed on a balcony overlooking the plaza. The police were awaiting for my orders.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gestured at them to bring out the..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured at them to bring out the prisoners. The doors of the police vehicles opened.
entries.menuText: Gesture at them to bring out the prisoners.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd's energy was very mixed...."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd's energy was very mixed. Some of them were cheering, some of them were curious, some of them were disapproving.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The maximum security prison's tall..."
entries.dialogueText: The maximum security prison's tall metal gates opened and a convoy of vehicles followed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The convoy was escorted on all side..."
entries.dialogueText: The convoy was escorted on all sides by many police cars and armored police carriers. Soon, they arrived at the Grand Garden inside Palas Rezna, where the executions were to take place.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had gathered nearly all of the no..."
entries.dialogueText: I had gathered nearly all of the nobles in Rizia to witness today's events. Many were in a party mood, having drinks and enjoying themselves.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Sila Orica had been placed on a..."
entries.dialogueText: The Sila Orica had been placed on a balcony overlooking the gardens. The police were awaiting my orders.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gestured at them to bring out the..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured at them to bring out the prisoners. The doors of the police vehicles opened.
entries.menuText: Gesture at them to bring out the prisoners.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The maximum security prison's tall..."
entries.dialogueText: The maximum security prison's tall metal gates opened and my convoy entered the prison compound.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of the two bridges connecting t..."
entries.dialogueText: One of the two bridges connecting the island of Porte Drazon Citadel to the mainland was slowly lowered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was escorted by many police as I..."
entries.dialogueText: I was escorted by many police as I made my way into the age-old execution chamber. The air was damp inside and the place was a little unclean for my taste.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The prison warden gave me a quick t..."
entries.dialogueText: The prison warden gave me a quick tour of the facilities and ensured me that no one has never escaped the Citadel before.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was led to the courtyard where th..."
entries.dialogueText: I was led to the courtyard where the executions would take place. I took a seat. The police were awaiting my orders.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gestured for them to bring out th..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured for them to bring out the prisoners. The door to the courtyard opened.
entries.menuText: Gesture for them to bring out the prisoners.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Police officers lined the condemned..."
entries.dialogueText: Police officers lined the condemned next to the electrocution chairs. They all had black bags on their heads.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Police officers lined up the condem..."
entries.dialogueText: Police officers lined up the condemned next to the poles for the firing squad. They all had black bags on their heads.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Police officers lined up the condem..."
entries.dialogueText: Police officers lined up the condemned next to the towering guillotines. They all had black bags on their heads.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Police officers lined up the condem..."
entries.dialogueText: Police officers lined up the condemned next to the gallows. They all had black bags on their heads.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The executioner walked in after sig..."
entries.dialogueText: The executioner walked in after signalling the officers to leave. He was a short, pudgy-looking man. Nothing about him gave away the idea that his job was to kill people.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He had an emotionless face, as if t..."
entries.dialogueText: He had an emotionless face, as if this was just a regular day for him. The same face a clerk would make when processing their taxes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An involuntary shiver ran down my s..."
entries.dialogueText: An involuntary shiver ran down my spine.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Calmly he came before me and bowed,..."
entries.dialogueText: Calmly he came before me and bowed, waiting for my instructions.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would like to speak to the death..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would like to speak to the death row inmates."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No need to waste time.""
entries.dialogueText: "No need to waste time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded and moved aside."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded and moved aside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I immediately recognized the subjec..."
entries.dialogueText: I immediately recognized the subject of my execution order, standing alongside a number of other inmates whose time had come as well.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pulled the black bags off each i..."
entries.dialogueText: He pulled the black bags off each inmate's head to reveal their faces.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't waste my breath on you peo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't waste my breath on you people anymore."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will all be forgotten. I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will all be forgotten. I will remove you from the annals of history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have committed grave crimes ag..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have committed grave crimes against Rizia. I hereby punish you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am only doing my royal duty as t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am only doing my royal duty as the King of Rizia. I hope you will use these last moments to repent."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have been waiting for this for a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have been waiting for this for a long time. I will savor every second of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The destiny of our countries has a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The destiny of our countries has always been to be together. Yet, here we are."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will personally make sure your r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will personally make sure your remains are transported back to your relatives in Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Maybe now you will finally get to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe now you will finally get to meet your dear God."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will burn in hell for an etern..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will burn in hell for an eternity for what you have done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is truly sad to see a once-godl..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is truly sad to see a once-godly man indulge in such crimes against the crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So young. A pity, really.""
entries.dialogueText: "So young. A pity, really."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You share the fate of your father...."
entries.dialogueText: "You share the fate of your father. Perhaps it is true that nothing good comes out of House Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Once the heir of a great family. N..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once the heir of a great family. Now look at what your dynasty has come to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your gold will not save you now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your gold will not save you now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your endless greed has ended you...."
entries.dialogueText: "Your endless greed has ended you. Ironic."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This shouldn't have been your demi..."
entries.dialogueText: "This shouldn't have been your demise. I am disappointed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wiktor Smolak sends his regards.""
entries.dialogueText: "Wiktor Smolak sends his regards."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It pains me to do this to a member..."
entries.dialogueText: "It pains me to do this to a member of my own family, but your incompetence and treason have left me with no choice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You dared to betray your King. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "You dared to betray your King. The leader of your own House! You deserve this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry, Luce. It's nothing pers..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Luce. It's nothing personal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""House Azaro will fall because of y..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro will fall because of you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If only I could execute you twice.""
entries.dialogueText: "If only I could execute you twice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From a great general to a death ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "From a great general to a death row inmate. What a sorry sight."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father should have executed you..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father should have executed you long ago. Perhaps none of this would have happened."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The only thing you have brought to..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only thing you have brought to your family is shame."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I accept my fate, Your Majesty. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I accept my fate, Your Majesty. I apologize for failing you and this kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stared at me, every muscle in h..."
entries.dialogueText: She stared at me, every muscle in her body practically vibrating with constrained rage.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Shut up and get it over with, cous..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shut up and get it over with, cousin."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You're making a mistake, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're making a mistake, Your Majesty. Do you know the fortune that awaits you if you let me go? We could make billions together!"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your time will come as well, King..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your time will come as well, King Romus. This will only fuel the people's rage."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Curse you and your family, Romus t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Curse you and your family, Romus the First. You deserve to die the same death that your father did."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I have lost... everything.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have lost... everything."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He fell on his knees on the ground...."
entries.dialogueText: He fell on his knees on the ground. The guards helped him up on his feet again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He spit on the ground."
entries.dialogueText: He spit on the ground.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked proud and unfazed."
entries.dialogueText: He looked proud and unfazed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On seeing my impassive face, he abr..."
entries.dialogueText: On seeing my impassive face, he abruptly assumed a pleading tone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He did not dare look into my eyes."
entries.dialogueText: He did not dare look into my eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The venom in her voice almost made..."
entries.dialogueText: The venom in her voice almost made me take a step back.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked defeated and weak."
entries.dialogueText: He looked defeated and weak.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The executioner looked at me for th..."
entries.dialogueText: The executioner looked at me for the final order.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gestured at him to begin."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured at him to begin.
entries.menuText: Gesture for the executions to start.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With an off-putting smile, he moved..."
entries.dialogueText: With an off-putting smile, he moved over to the line. The guards followed his lead.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soon after, all of them were tied t..."
entries.dialogueText: Soon after, all of them were tied to the electric chairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Their heads were shaved and wetted..."
entries.dialogueText: Their heads were shaved and wetted with a sponge dipped in a bucket of water.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soon after, all of them were tied t..."
entries.dialogueText: Soon after, all of them were tied to the poles.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Their eyes were blindfolded."
entries.dialogueText: Their eyes were blindfolded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soon after, all of them kneeling un..."
entries.dialogueText: Soon after, all of them kneeling under the sharp blade of the guillotine.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They could not even look up to see."
entries.dialogueText: They could not even look up to see.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soon after, all of them were on the..."
entries.dialogueText: Soon after, all of them were on the gallows with ropes around their necks.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Their hands were kept cuffed."
entries.dialogueText: Their hands were kept cuffed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Their final rites were read to them..."
entries.dialogueText: Their final rites were read to them as well as prayers for the ones who requested it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The executioner held his hand up to..."
entries.dialogueText: The executioner held his hand up to signal.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will see you all in hell.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will see you all in hell."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Do it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His hand went down and the signal w..."
entries.dialogueText: His hand went down and the signal was given.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The lever was turned all the way up..."
entries.dialogueText: The lever was turned all the way up and the voltage was increased to maximum. A terrible smell filled the air.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They were no more."
entries.dialogueText: They were no more.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The firing squad loaded their rifle..."
entries.dialogueText: The firing squad loaded their rifles, pointed and shot at the prisoners in unison.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The rope was cut and the huge blade..."
entries.dialogueText: The rope was cut and the huge blades of the guillotines made their way down. Blood gushed from the prisoners' necks as their heads rolled into the baskets in front.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The rope was cut and the wooden boa..."
entries.dialogueText: The rope was cut and the wooden board beneath the prisoners' feet gave way. Some of their necks snapped immediately; others clutched at their throats, struggling for breath.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a short while, the jerking mo..."
entries.dialogueText: After a short while, the jerking motions of the lifeless bodies stopped.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The entire plaza let out a collecti..."
entries.dialogueText: The entire plaza let out a collective gasp. Camera flashes went off. Then slowly, clapping began from the crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The nobles let out a collective gas..."
entries.dialogueText: The nobles let out a collective gasp. I felt that they were looking at me in a new light. I was more feared and respected now than ever.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will burn in hell for what you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will burn in hell for what you did to both Rizia and Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Please, Your Majesty.... I mean it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty.... I mean it. I'll do anything... Anything!"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And that of your own daughter.""
entries.dialogueText: "And that of your own daughter."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I immediately recognized the subjec..."
entries.dialogueText: I immediately recognized the subjects of my execution order, standing alongside a number of other inmates whose time had come as well.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You earned my respect, only to bet..."
entries.dialogueText: "You earned my respect, only to betray me. What do you have to say for yourself?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Fuck off, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fuck off, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pabel Adria.""
entries.dialogueText: "Pabel Adria."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Bi mare volu...""
entries.dialogueText: "Bi mare volu..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where is my daughter?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where is my daughter?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish this had gone differently.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wish this had gone differently."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Far away from you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Far away from you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: He shook his head.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You've changed, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "You've changed, Romus."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""So do I, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "So do I, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I'm sorry, Rom. But you've changed.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Rom. But you've changed."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""My loyalty had its limits, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "My loyalty had its limits, Your Majesty. You found them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For humiliating the Royal Family o..."
entries.dialogueText: "For humiliating the Royal Family of Rizia, you will pay the ultimate price."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: He shook his head.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I am not the humiliation here.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am not the humiliation here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took a last, regretful look at m..."
entries.dialogueText: He took a last, regretful look at me as the hood was placed back on his head.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Death Row Final Words Hub]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus Gordion.""
entries.dialogueText: "Titus Gordion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To think that I trusted you with t..."
entries.dialogueText: "To think that I trusted you with the security of me and my family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You bit the hand that fed you.""
entries.dialogueText: "You bit the hand that fed you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May you burn in hell.""
entries.dialogueText: "May you burn in hell."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Alongside you, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Alongside you, sir."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""To think that I trusted you with l..."
entries.dialogueText: "To think that I trusted you with leading this country."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The only thing you could feed peop..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only thing you could feed people with is poison, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stood defiant and emotionless."
entries.dialogueText: He stood defiant and emotionless.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hugo Toras.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hugo Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are not worthy of the Toras na..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are not worthy of the Toras name."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You were almost a father to me...""
entries.dialogueText: "You were almost a father to me..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May you meet my father in hell.""
entries.dialogueText: "May you meet my father in hell."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We will wait for you to join us.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will wait for you to join us."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Everything I ever did was for our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything I ever did was for our house. But I worry it has all been for nothing."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And you were almost a son...""
entries.dialogueText: "And you were almost a son..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He had the look of a broken man. He..."
entries.dialogueText: He had the look of a broken man. He lowered his eyes and said no more.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Death Row Final Words Hub]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fitting, isn't it? For you and you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fitting, isn't it? For you and your failure of a son to die together."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I beg you, Romus. Kill me if you m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I beg you, Romus. Kill me if you must, but spare my boy..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Angelica Sazon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Angelica Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I gave you a chance to redeem your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I gave you a chance to redeem yourself, and you abused it. Your punishment is well earned."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father should have done this ye..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father should have done this years ago."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How fitting for you to die alongsi..."
entries.dialogueText: "How fitting for you to die alongside your son. Your treacherous legacy ends today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A pity you couldn't fall in line l..."
entries.dialogueText: "A pity you couldn't fall in line like your son did. Your treachery ends today."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I regret nothing.""
entries.dialogueText: "I regret nothing."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""This is not the end of House Sazon..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is not the end of House Sazon. Rizia's noblest family will survive the tyranny of Romus Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Adarfo Sotelato.""
entries.dialogueText: "Adarfo Sotelato."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're a sham. You never truly wan..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a sham. You never truly wanted to make people's lives better. You only wanted to seize power."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your revolution has failed, like s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your revolution has failed, like so many others before it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is your last chance. Acknowle..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is your last chance. Acknowledge me as your rightful king, and I'll clear you of all charges."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""You don't mean that. But even if y..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't mean that. But even if you did, I would gladly accept death before bowing to you."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""It lives on in the hearts of the R..."
entries.dialogueText: "It lives on in the hearts of the Rizian people. One day -- sooner than you think -- they will have their vengeance."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I cannot take these words seriousl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot take these words seriously coming from an absolute monarch."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He held his head high."
entries.dialogueText: He held his head high.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Death Row Final Words Hub]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Look over there at your daughter...."
entries.dialogueText: "Look over there at your daughter. The all-powerful House of Azaro has been reduced to nothing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes filled with tears. He move..."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes filled with tears. He moved his lips, but no words came out.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your hubris will be your downfall...."
entries.dialogueText: "Your hubris will be your downfall. House Azaro will not go down that easily."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He tried to project defiance, but t..."
entries.dialogueText: He tried to project defiance, but there was defeat in his eyes.
